records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Gratz for making it this far, but I’m basically unbeatable.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Поздравляю, вы добрались сюда, но меня практически невозможно победить.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: I don't even need to fight, this is the life!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Мне даже сражаться не нужно, вот это жизнь!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: I can summon lots of undead! Check this out.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Я могу призвать целую толпу нежити! Смотрите.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Oh I'm dead!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Ой, я умер!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Sike!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: А вот и нет!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Alright, maybe I'm just weak after all..
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Ладно, может, я и правда слабак..

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: But my masters are a lot stronger..
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Но мои учителя гораздо сильнее..

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Just you wait...
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Ну погодите...

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Stop.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Хватит.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: You're not funny.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Не смешно.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Wait..
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Погодите..

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Cringe.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Какой позор.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Give me 1 sec..
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Дайте мне 1 секунду..

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Lame.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Отстой.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Leave me alone!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Оставьте меня в покое!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Fight my Undeads instead.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Лучше сразитесь с моей нежитью.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Why are you running?
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Куда вы бежите?

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Cheater!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Обманщик!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Hacker!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Читер!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Not fair!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Нечестно!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: OUCH!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: АЙ!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: All I have are positive thoughts.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: У меня только позитивные мысли.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Do you want a balloon?
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Хотите воздушный шарик?

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Run, run, run, RUN!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Бегите, бегите, бегите, БЕГИТЕ!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Weeeeeeeee
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Уииииииии!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Hoho, looks like you killed me!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Хо-хо, похоже, вы меня убили!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: You fools!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Глупцы!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: You fell victim to one of the classic blunders!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Вы попались на одну из классических уловок!

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: Check mate.
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Шах и мат.

records.speaker: Bonzo
records.source: [BOSS] Bonzo: I can revive myself and become much stronger!
records.translation: [BOSS] Bonzo: Я могу воскреснуть и стать гораздо сильнее!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Little ants, plotting and scheming, thinking they are invincible…
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Жалкие муравьи плетут интриги и строят козни, считая себя непобедимыми…

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: I won’t let you break the factory core, I gave my life to my Master.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Я не позволю вам разрушить ядро фабрики. Я посвятил свою жизнь господину.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: No one matches me in close quarters.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: В ближнем бою мне нет равных.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Punishment served, nothing survives my reach.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Приговор исполнен. Никто не выживет, попав ко мне в руки.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: You have done it, you destroyed the factory…
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Вы всё-таки сделали это, вы разрушили фабрику…

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: But you have nowhere to hide anymore!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Но теперь вам негде спрятаться!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: YOU ARE FACE TO FACE WITH GOLDOR!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: ВЫ СТОИТЕ ЛИЦОМ К ЛИЦУ С ГОЛДОРОМ!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Necron, forgive me.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Некрон, прости меня.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: FINALLY! This took way too long.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: НАКОНЕЦ-ТО! Как же долго это тянулось.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Раз уж ты стал призраком, поможешь мне прибраться?

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Closer to me!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Ближе ко мне!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: CLOSER!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: БЛИЖЕ!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Come Closer!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Подойдите ближе!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Do you really think we won’t repair everything? Your impact will be minuscule!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Неужели вы думаете, что мы всё не починим? Ваши усилия ничего не изменят!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: I am the death zone, you are smart to flee.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Рядом со мной — верная смерть. Что ж, бегство — разумный выбор.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: You are breaking precious materials, unforgivable.
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Вы уничтожаете ценные материалы. Это непростительно.

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: What do you think you are doing there!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Что вы там себе позволяете?!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Stop touching those terminals!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Не трогайте эти терминалы!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: You can't damage me, you can barely slow me down!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Вам меня не ранить, вы едва способны меня замедлить!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: Slowing me down only prolongs your pain!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Замедляя меня, вы лишь продлеваете свои мучения!

records.speaker: Goldor
records.source: [BOSS] Goldor: There is no stopping me down there!
records.translation: [BOSS] Goldor: Внизу меня уже ничто не остановит!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: WELL WELL WELL LOOK WHO'S HERE!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: НУ-НУ-НУ, ПОСМОТРИТЕ, КТО К НАМ ПОЖАЛОВАЛ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I'VE BEEN TOLD I COULD HAVE A BIT OF FUN WITH YOU.
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: МНЕ СКАЗАЛИ, С ВАМИ МОЖНО НЕМНОГО ПОРАЗВЛЕЧЬСЯ.

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: DON'T DISAPPOINT ME, I HAVEN'T HAD A GOOD FIGHT IN A WHILE.
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: НЕ РАЗОЧАРУЙТЕ МЕНЯ, Я ДАВНО КАК СЛЕДУЕТ НЕ СРАЖАЛСЯ.

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: YOU TRICKED ME!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: ВЫ МЕНЯ ОБМАНУЛИ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: THAT BEAM! IT HURTS! IT HURTS!!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: ЭТОТ ЛУЧ! БОЛЬНО! КАК ЖЕ БОЛЬНО!!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I'M TOO YOUNG TO DIE AGAIN!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: Я СЛИШКОМ МОЛОД, ЧТОБЫ СНОВА УМИРАТЬ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I'LL MAKE YOU REMEMBER MY DEATH!!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: Я ЗАСТАВЛЮ ВАС ЗАПОМНИТЬ МОЮ СМЕРТЬ!!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: FINALLY! This took way too long.
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: НАКОНЕЦ-ТО! Как же долго это тянулось.

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: Раз уж ты стал призраком, поможешь мне прибраться?

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: YOUR WEAPONS CAN'T PIERCE THROUGH MY SHIELD!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: ВАШЕ ОРУЖИЕ НЕ ПРОБЬЁТ МОЙ ЩИТ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: YOUR MOBILITY TRICKS DON'T WORK IN MY DOMAIN!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: ВАШИ УЛОВКИ С ПЕРЕМЕЩЕНИЕМ НЕ РАБОТАЮТ В МОИХ ВЛАДЕНИЯХ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: I HOPE YOU LIKE EXPLOSIONS TOO!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: НАДЕЮСЬ, ВЫ ТОЖЕ ЛЮБИТЕ ВЗРЫВЫ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: MY MINIONS WILL HAVE TO WIPE THE FLOOR AFTER I'M DONE WITH YOU ALL!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: КОГДА Я С ВАМИ ПОКОНЧУ, МОИМ ПРИСЛУЖНИКАМ ПРИДЁТСЯ ОТМЫВАТЬ ПОЛ!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: How about you taste some rapid fire Wither Skulls!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: Как насчёт скоростной очереди из черепов иссушителя?!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: Eat Wither Skulls, scum!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: Получайте черепами иссушителя, отребье!

records.speaker: Maxor
records.source: [BOSS] Maxor: Time for me to blast you away for good!
records.translation: [BOSS] Maxor: Пора взорвать вас раз и навсегда!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Finally, I heard so much about you. The Eye likes you very much.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Наконец-то. Я столько о вас слышал. Око очень к вам благосклонно.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: I'm afraid, your journey ends now.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Боюсь, здесь ваше путешествие заканчивается.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: My master and I spent centuries building this factory...and this army.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Мы с моим господином веками строили эту фабрику... и эту армию.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: I won't allow you to destroy it all now.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Я не позволю вам теперь всё уничтожить.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Goodbye.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Прощайте.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: That's a very impressive trick. I guess I'll have to handle this myself.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Очень впечатляющий трюк. Видимо, придётся разобраться с вами лично.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: I ensure you, these blades are far sharper than Goldor's ever were.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Уверяю вас, эти клинки куда острее, чем когда-либо были у Голдора.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: I understand your words now, my master.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Теперь я понимаю ваши слова, мой господин.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: The Catacombs... are no more.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Катакомб... больше нет.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: FINALLY! This took way too long.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: НАКОНЕЦ-ТО! Как же долго это тянулось.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Раз уж ты стал призраком, поможешь мне прибраться?

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: You merely adopted the Catacombs! I was molded by them!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Вы лишь освоились в Катакомбах! Меня же они создали!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: I - Necron - was destined to rule over Mankind! Dead or Alive!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Мне — Некрону — суждено править человечеством! Живым или мёртвым!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: The Catacombs made you stronger, but can you beat me?!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Катакомбы сделали вас сильнее, но сможете ли вы одолеть меня?!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Show me how you beat Storm!!!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Покажите, как вы победили Шторма!!!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Not just your Village, but the whole world will end!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Погибнет не только ваша деревня, но и весь мир!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Fight for your life!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Сражайтесь за свою жизнь!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Sometimes when you have a problem, you just need to destroy it all and start again.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Иногда, столкнувшись с проблемой, нужно просто всё уничтожить и начать заново.

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: WITNESS MY RAW NUCLEAR POWER!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: УЗРИТЕ МОЮ НЕОБУЗДАННУЮ ЯДЕРНУЮ МОЩЬ!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: IF YOU WANT TO STAY COOL, DON'T LOOK!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: НЕ ХОТИТЕ ПОДЖАРИТЬСЯ — НЕ СМОТРИТЕ!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: БАААААААААААААААААААААААМ!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: HASTA LA VISTA, BABY!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: ДО ВСТРЕЧИ, ДЕТКА!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: ARGH!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: АРГХ!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: That is enough, fool!
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Довольно, глупец!

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with...
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Искатели приключений! Не забывайте, с кем связались...

records.speaker: Necron
records.source: [BOSS] Necron: Before I have to deal with you myself.
records.translation: [BOSS] Necron: Иначе мне придётся заняться вами лично.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: The audacity! I have been the ruler of these floors for a hundred years!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Какая наглость! Я правлю этими этажами уже сотню лет!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I am the bridge between this realm and the world below! You shall not pass!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Я — мост между этим миром и миром внизу! Вы не пройдёте!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You've managed to kill a Giant! Good luck with the rest of them!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Вам удалось убить гиганта! Удачи с остальными!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Wow, one Giant down already? You guys are good!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Ого, один гигант уже повержен? А вы неплохи!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: How many players does it take to kill a Giant?
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Сколько игроков нужно, чтобы убить гиганта?

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You killed my weakest Giant!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Вы убили самого слабого из моих гигантов!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Uh oh! Half of my Giant creations have bit the dust! Whatever will I do?
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Ой-ой! Половина моих гигантских творений уже полегла! Что же мне делать?

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: 2 of my Giants down?! No matter, these last two are tough!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: 2 моих гиганта повержены?! Неважно, последние двое покрепче!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: That Giant was weak! I clearly screwed up during the necromancy process.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Этот гигант был слаб! Я явно напортачил при его воскрешении.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I'm starting to sweat!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Что-то мне становится жарко!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Down to 1 Giant!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Остался всего 1 гигант!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Whoops! There goes my third Giant!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Упс! Вот и третий мой гигант пал!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: My Terracotta Army is using some of the finest souls - old warriors and wizards!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: В моей Терракотовой армии — лучшие души древних воинов и волшебников!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You will be humbled, reckless humans!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Я собью с вас спесь, безрассудные люди!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Can you at least enjoy my science, pushing the boundaries of Necromancy!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Так оцените же мою науку, раздвигающую границы некромантии!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Corpses are deficient, full of weaknesses. Statues are stronger, faster, and easier to repair.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Трупы несовершенны, у них полно слабостей. Статуи сильнее, быстрее, и чинить их проще.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Can't you see that there is no winning? This room will be your tomb.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Неужели не ясно, что вам не победить? Эта комната станет вашей гробницей.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: So much effort, for what? You should have joined us instead, Necron will cure this world!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Столько усилий — и ради чего? Лучше бы вы присоединились к нам. Некрон исцелит этот мир!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Terrible...terrible...,
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Ужасно... ужасно...,

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I'm growing tired of this folly. My Giants are restless.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Мне надоедает этот фарс. Мои гиганты уже заждались.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: It's about time we see what my Giants can do...
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Пора посмотреть, на что способны мои гиганты...

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Rumor has it those are dead Precursors, legendary civilization.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Поговаривают, это мёртвые Предтечи из легендарной цивилизации.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: My first time using them, extremely interesting!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Впервые пускаю их в дело, чрезвычайно интересно!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Which one is your favorite? Those laser eyes...beautiful!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Который вам больше нравится? Эти лазерные глаза... прекрасны!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: This is what peak Necromancy looks like!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Вот она — вершина некромантии!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Boulders, lasers, stomping, and giant swords! Oh my!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Валуны, лазеры, топот и гигантские мечи! Вот это да!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: My giants! Unleashed!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Мои гиганты! На свободу!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: If only you had become my disciples instead of this incompetent bunch.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Вот бы вы стали моими учениками вместо этой никчёмной шайки.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Maybe in another life. Until then, meet my ultimate corpse.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Может, в другой жизни. А пока познакомьтесь с моим величайшим мертвецом.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: I'm sorry but I need to concentrate. I wish it didn't have to come to this.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Простите, мне нужно сосредоточиться. Жаль, что до этого дошло.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: You thought I'd fall for the same tricks as those before me? Not today!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Думали, я попадусь на те же уловки, что и мои предшественники? Не дождётесь!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: It was inevitable. You are fighting forces beyond your imagination.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Это было неизбежно. Вы сражаетесь с силами, которых даже не можете вообразить.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: No adventurer can see what lays beyond this floor.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Ни один искатель приключений не увидит, что ждёт за этим этажом.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: Rest in peace.
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: Покойтесь с миром.

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: NOOOOOOOOO!!! THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE!!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: НЕЕЕЕЕЕЕТ!!! ЭТО НЕВОЗМОЖНО!!

records.speaker: Sadan
records.source: [BOSS] Sadan: FATHER, FORGIVE ME!!!
records.translation: [BOSS] Sadan: ОТЕЦ, ПРОСТИ МЕНЯ!!!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: This is where the journey ends for you, Adventurers.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Здесь ваше путешествие заканчивается, искатели приключений.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: The last few who tried fighting me are now in those Crypts.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Последние смельчаки, решившие со мной сразиться, теперь покоятся в тех склепах.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: If you can beat my Undeads, I'll personally grant you the privilege to replace them.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Если одолеете мою нежить, я лично удостою вас чести занять её место.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: ARISE, MY CREATIONS!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: ВОССТАНЬТЕ, МОИ ТВОРЕНИЯ!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: This should be interesting.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Будет интересно.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Those toys are not strong enough I see.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Вижу, эти игрушки недостаточно сильны.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Don't get too excited though.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Но не радуйтесь раньше времени.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Did you forget? I was taught by the best! Let's dance.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Забыли? Меня учили лучшие! Потанцуем.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Where is my Priest!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Где мой жрец?!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Warrior! Charge this fool!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Воин! В атаку на этого глупца!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Back off!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Отойдите!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: OUCH!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: АЙ!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Oof
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Уф.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: You'd make a great Undead minion!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Из тебя выйдет отличный прислужник-нежить!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: I can't believe Bonzo lost to someone so weak!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Не верится, что Бонзо проиграл такому слабаку!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: No more hiding!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Хватит прятаться!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: I'll send you to the Wither Realm!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Я отправлю вас в мир иссушителей!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Just who do you think I am!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: За кого вы меня принимаете?!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Dodge this!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Увернитесь-ка от этого!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Soon I'll be shooting your skull!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Скоро я буду стрелять твоим черепом!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Necro no Jutsu!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Некро но дзюцу!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Yare yare daze...
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Ну и ну...

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: I'm going to be the Wither King!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Я стану Королём иссушителей!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Wither Ultra!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Иссушитель ультра!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Fine then! I'll take you myself!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Ну что ж! Я сам с вами разберусь!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: That was nothing my Priest can't heal!
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Мой жрец и не такое исцелит!

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: I always knew I would win...I'm a genius.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Я всегда знал, что выиграю... Я ведь гений.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: But don't worry I'll add you to my collection.
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Но не волнуйтесь, я добавлю вас в свою коллекцию.

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: In a way, you'll live forever...
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: В каком-то смысле вы будете жить вечно...

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: Whatever...
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Да какая разница...

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: You'll never beat my teacher..
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Вам никогда не победить моего учителя..

records.speaker: Scarf
records.source: [BOSS] Scarf: His technique.. is too advanced..
records.translation: [BOSS] Scarf: Его техника... слишком совершенна..

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Don't boast about beating this simple minded Wither.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Не хвастайтесь победой над этим недалёким иссушителем.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: My abilities are unparalleled, in many ways I am the last bastion.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Моим способностям нет равных. Во многом я — последний рубеж обороны.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: The memory of your death will be your fondest, focus up!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Воспоминание о вашей смерти станет для вас самым приятным. Соберитесь!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: The power of lightning is quite phenomenal. A single strike can vaporize a person whole.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Мощь молнии поистине невероятна. Один удар способен полностью испарить человека.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: I'd be happy to show you what that's like!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: С удовольствием покажу вам, каково это!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: THUNDER LET ME BE YOUR CATALYST!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: ГРОМ, ДАЙ МНЕ ПРОБУДИТЬ ТВОЮ СИЛУ!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: ENERGY HEED MY CALL!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: ЭНЕРГИЯ, ВНЕМЛИ МОЕМУ ЗОВУ!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Bahahaha! Not a single intact pillar remains!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Бу-ха-ха! Ни одной целой колонны не осталось!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Rejoice, your last moments are with me and my lightning.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Радуйтесь, последние мгновения вы проведёте со мной и моими молниями.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: I should have known that I stood no chance.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Нужно было понимать, что у меня нет шансов.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: At least my son died by your hands.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: По крайней мере, мой сын погиб от ваших рук.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: FINALLY! This took way too long.
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: НАКОНЕЦ-ТО! Как же долго это тянулось.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Раз уж ты стал призраком, поможешь мне прибраться?

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: The Age of Men is over, we are creating tens, hundreds of withers!!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Век людей окончен, мы создаём десятки, сотни иссушителей!!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Not just your land, but every kingdom will soon be ruled by our army of undead!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Скоро не только ваши земли, но и каждое королевство окажется под властью нашей армии нежити!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: The days are numbered until I am finally unleashed again on the world!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Считаные дни остались до того, как я вновь обрушусь на этот мир!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: No more adventurers, no more heroes, death and thunder!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Никаких больше искателей приключений, никаких героев — лишь смерть и гром!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Fool, I'd hide under something next time if I were you!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Глупец, на твоём месте я бы в следующий раз под чем-нибудь спрятался!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Oof
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Уф.

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Ouch, that hurt!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Ай, больно же!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: THAT WAS ONLY IN MY WAY!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: ЭТО ВСЕГО ЛИШЬ МЕШАЛО МНЕ!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: This factory is too small for me!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: Эта фабрика для меня слишком мала!

records.speaker: Storm
records.source: [BOSS] Storm: Slowing me down will be your greatest accomplishment!
records.translation: [BOSS] Storm: То, что вам удалось меня замедлить, станет вашим величайшим достижением!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I was burdened with terrible news recently...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Недавно до меня дошла ужасная весть...

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My most talented student...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Мой самый талантливый ученик...

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I'll show you real power!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Я покажу вам настоящую силу!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: You took one of them down, but that won't be enough!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Вы одолели одного из них, но этого мало!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I'm afraid I can quickly revive any one of my Guardians!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Боюсь, я могу быстро воскресить любого из моих стражей!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My barrier is weakening, but it still holds strong!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Мой барьер слабеет, но всё ещё держится!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Two Guardians, impressive...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Два стража, впечатляет...

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: What?! Nobody has managed to take three of my Guardians down before!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Что?! Ещё никому не удавалось одолеть троих моих стражей!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My Guardians!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Мои стражи!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My technique is much more advanced than Scarf's..
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Моя техника гораздо совершеннее, чем у Скарфа..

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My barrier will hold as long as my Guardians are alive.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Мой барьер будет держаться, пока живы мои стражи.

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Give up Adventurers, it only takes me a few seconds to revive my guardians.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Сдавайтесь, искатели приключений. Мне нужно лишь несколько секунд, чтобы воскресить стражей.

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I can do this all day.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Я могу заниматься этим целый день.

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Perfect offense and defense, I am INVINCIBLE!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Идеальное нападение и защита. Я НЕПОБЕДИМ!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: No more hiding!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Хватит прятаться!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Dodge this!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Увернитесь-ка от этого!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Here! Catch!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Ловите!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Here's a curveball for you!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: А вот и сюрприз!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Oh? You found my Guardians' one weakness?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: О? Вы нашли единственную слабость моих стражей?

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Even if you took my barrier down, I can still fight.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Пусть вы и разрушили мой барьер, я всё ещё могу сражаться.

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: This time I'll be your opponent!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Теперь вашим противником буду я!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: These wounds are nothing for my Giga Heal!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Моё гигаисцеление легко справится с этими ранами!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: How do you like the taste of Gunpowder?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Ну как вам вкус пороха?

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Another flawless Giga Heal. You are making this too easy for me!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Ещё одно безупречное гигаисцеление. С вами всё слишком просто!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Понятно. Вы вынудили меня прибегнуть к моей высшей технике.

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: These Guardians aren't just for show I'm afraid!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Боюсь, эти стражи здесь не для красоты!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: The process is irreversible, but I'll be stronger than a Wither now!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Процесс необратим, зато теперь я стану сильнее иссушителя!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Now that you have fallen, my student has been avenged.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Теперь, когда вы пали, мой ученик отомщён.

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: Picking a fight with me and my experiments will only lead to your demise!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Решив сразиться со мной и моими творениями, вы лишь обрекли себя на гибель!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I give you an F-!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Ставлю вам кол с минусом!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: What?! My Guardian power is unbeatable!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Что?! Силу моих стражей невозможно одолеть!

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: How could you... I needed more power...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Как вы могли... Мне нужно было больше силы...

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: I can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m-
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Нельзя, чтобы мой господин узнал об этом... он меня убь-

records.speaker: The Professor
records.source: [BOSS] The Professor: My Guardians! Show them your power!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Professor: Мои стражи! Покажите им свою мощь!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Congratulations, you made it through the Entrance.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Поздравляю, вы прошли Вход.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I have been watching you closely...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я внимательно за вами наблюдал...

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Unfortunately, for now, this is the end of the road.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: К сожалению, пока что здесь ваш путь заканчивается.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I sense many dead spirits eager to return to the living..
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я чувствую множество душ умерших, жаждущих вернуться к живым..

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I will bring some of them back. Watch this.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я верну некоторых из них. Смотрите.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ah, you've finally arrived.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: А, вот вы наконец и пришли.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I have been watching you closely since we last met.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: С нашей последней встречи я пристально за вами наблюдал.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I don't know if you are ready for what's behind this door.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Не знаю, готовы ли вы к тому, что ждёт за этой дверью.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: So I will decide if you are strong enough.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Поэтому я решу, достаточно ли вы сильны.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ah, we meet again...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: А, вот мы и снова встретились...

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I have done some experiments to develop new abilities for my Skulls.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я провёл эксперименты, чтобы наделить мои черепа новыми способностями.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Let's see how you handle this!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Посмотрим, как вы с этим справитесь!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: So you made it this far... interesting.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Значит, вы добрались сюда... интересно.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You are much stronger than I was expecting.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Вы гораздо сильнее, чем я ожидал.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Not to worry, I recently added a very fine piece to my collection!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ничего страшного, недавно моя коллекция пополнилась весьма достойным экземпляром!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You've managed to scratch and claw your way here, eh?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Значит, всё-таки сумели пробиться сюда?

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Don't even think about trying to outwit me this time!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: На этот раз даже не пытайтесь меня перехитрить!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: My Watchful Eyes are keeping their...eyes...on you!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Мои Бдительные глаза не спускают с вас... глаз!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I'm starting to get tired of seeing you around here...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Мне начинает надоедать ваше присутствие...

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: This time I've imbued my minions with special properties!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: На этот раз я наделил своих прислужников особыми свойствами!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be healthier than any summon I've ever created!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: У этих будет больше здоровья, чем у любого из моих прежних созданий!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be adorned in the finest gold!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Эти будут облачены в лучшее золото!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will strike thunder from the sky!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Эти будут призывать молнии с небес!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be stubborn and unwilling to change!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Эти будут упрямыми и не захотят меняться!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be quick and agile!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Эти будут быстрыми и проворными!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: These will be kinda hard to see ngl.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Этих, честно говоря, будет трудновато разглядеть.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Oh.. hello?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: О... привет?

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You've arrived too early, I haven't even set up..
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Вы пришли слишком рано, я ещё даже не подготовился..

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Anyway, let's fight.. I guess.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ладно, давайте сражаться... наверное.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Things feel a little more roomy now, eh?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Теперь тут немного просторнее, правда?

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I've knocked down those pillars to go for a more...open concept.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я снёс те колонны ради более... открытой планировки.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Plus I needed to give my new friends some space to roam...
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: И моим новым друзьям нужно было место, чтобы размяться...

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: This guy looks like a fighter.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Этот похож на бойца.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Go and live again!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Иди и живи снова!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Not bad.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Неплохо.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You'll do.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ты подойдёшь.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Go, fight!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Вперёд, сражайся!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Hmmm... this one!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Хм... вот этот!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Let's see how you can handle this.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Посмотрим, как вы с этим справитесь.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I'm impressed.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я впечатлён.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: That one was weak anyway.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Он всё равно был слабаком.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Aw, I liked that one.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Эх, а этот мне нравился.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Very nice.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Очень хорошо.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: That tickles.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Щекотно.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: I am not your enemy.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Я вам не враг.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Stop attacking me.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Перестаньте на меня нападать.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Don't make me shoot you.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Не вынуждайте меня в вас стрелять.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ouch.. just kidding.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ай... шучу.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: My Watchful Eyes see you up there! Come down and fight!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Мои Бдительные глаза видят вас там, наверху! Спускайтесь и сражайтесь!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: We are always watching. Come down from there!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Мы всегда наблюдаем. Спускайтесь оттуда!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: My Watchful Eyes see all!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Мои Бдительные глаза видят всё!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Don't try to sneak anything past my Watchful Eyes. They see you up there!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Не пытайтесь обмануть мои Бдительные глаза. Они видят вас там, наверху!

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: A Wandering Soul? Poor Guy.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Блуждающая душа? Бедняга.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: A Wandering Soul? Don't you guys have a Healer?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Блуждающая душа? У вас разве нет целителя?

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Oof.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Уф.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Wow, a Wandering Soul. Neat.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Ого, Блуждающая душа. Здорово.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: Oops. Wasn't meant to revive that one.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Упс. Этого воскрешать не стоило.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: That will be enough for now.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: На сегодня хватит.

records.speaker: The Watcher
records.source: [BOSS] The Watcher: You have failed to prove yourselves, and have paid with your lives.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Watcher: Вы не смогли доказать свою силу и поплатились за это жизнью.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Ohh?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: О-о?

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Awakening me from my slumber, what a strange choice.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Пробудить меня ото сна... Какой странный выбор.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I have nothing left to fight for, I finally had peace.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Мне больше не за что сражаться. Я наконец обрёл покой.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: You... again?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Снова... вы?

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Я больше не желаю сражаться, но знаю, что вас это не остановит.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: We will decide it all, here, now.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Мы решим всё здесь и сейчас.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: My enemies are now my strongest allies!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Мои враги теперь стали моими сильнейшими союзниками!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Does that mean Necron is no more? I have been a mediocre master.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Значит, Некрона больше нет? Посредственным же я был учителем.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Storm was my favorite sparring partner, you must have enjoyed fighting him!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Шторм был моим любимым партнёром для поединков. Уверен, вам понравилось с ним сражаться!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: This world isn’t worth fighting for, how can you be so determined?
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: За этот мир не стоит сражаться. Откуда у вас такая решимость?

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Mortals fighting against supreme beings, what a moving spectacle.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Смертные сражаются с высшими существами. Какое трогательное зрелище.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I enjoy your passion, if the circumstances had been different, we could have been friends.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Мне нравится ваше рвение. При других обстоятельствах мы могли бы стать друзьями.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I have worked on this spell for centuries.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Я трудился над этим заклинанием веками.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Some of you do have some talent, I can feel it, the other ones not so much.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: В некоторых из вас и правда есть талант, я чувствую его. В остальных — не особо.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: You are wasting your time.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Вы зря тратите время.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Did you forget? I am invincible!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Забыли? Я неуязвим!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: You don't have your sword this time!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: На этот раз у тебя нет меча!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Futile.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Тщетно.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: You just made a terrible mistake!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Вы только что совершили ужасную ошибку!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I am not impressed.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Не впечатляет.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Your skills have faded, humans.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Вы растеряли своё мастерство, люди.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Oh, this one hurts!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Ох, вот это больно!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: My soul is disposable.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Я могу пожертвовать своей душой.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I have more of those.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: У меня таких ещё много.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Thank you for coming all the way here.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Спасибо, что проделали весь этот путь.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Now I will truly have peace.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Теперь я действительно обрету покой.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Let's enjoy your final moments in silence.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Насладимся вашими последними мгновениями в тишине.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: Incredible. You did what I couldn't do myself.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Невероятно. Вы сделали то, чего я сам не смог.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: In a way I should thank you, I lost all hopes centuries ago that it would ever end.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: В каком-то смысле мне стоит вас поблагодарить. Ещё века назад я потерял всякую надежду, что это когда-нибудь закончится.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: I hope you’ll become the Heroes I could never be.
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Надеюсь, вы станете героями, каким я так и не смог стать.

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: So long champions of this mad world!
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Прощайте, защитники этого безумного мира!

records.speaker: The Wither King
records.source: [BOSS] The Wither King: My strengths are depleting, this… this is it…
records.translation: [BOSS] The Wither King: Силы покидают меня, это… это конец…

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Welcome Adventurers! I am Thorn, the Spirit! And host of the Vegan Trials!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Добро пожаловать, искатели приключений! Я Торн, дух и ведущий Веганских испытаний!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Моя арена — самое зрелищное место во всех Катакомбах!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Today you'll be our spectacle.
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Сегодня развлекать нас будете вы.

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Dance! Dance with my Spirit animals! And may you perish in a delightful way!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Танцуйте! Танцуйте с моими призрачными зверями! И умрите красиво!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Щекотно, щекотно — вам придётся несладко!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: I'm already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Я уже мёртв, искатель приключений! Земное оружие мне не навредит!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - I am Thorn the Spirit!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Не тратьте на меня силы, люди, — я дух Торн!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Мне нравится ваш боевой дух, но ваши уловки на меня не действуют!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Trying to damage me like that...desperate...
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Пытаться ранить меня так... от безысходности...

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: I feel...dizzy...
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: У меня... кружится голова...

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: It hurts...what a delicate feeling...
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Больно... какое тонкое ощущение...

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Round and round, another wound.
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Ещё один круг — и новая рана.

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: My energy, it goes away...
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Моя энергия уходит...

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Go my Spirits, go! Unsullied souls!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Вперёд, мои духи! Незапятнанные души!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: More Spirits! Born of feathers and light!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Ещё духов! Рождённых из перьев и света!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Dance for me humans! Your Art will be remembered!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Танцуйте для меня, люди! Ваше искусство запомнят!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Can you hear the crowd?! The sound of death!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Слышите толпу?! Голос смерти!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Jump and laugh, scream and cry! Be passionate!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Прыгайте и смейтесь, кричите и плачьте! Отдайтесь страсти!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Wonderful performance humans, truly beautiful.
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Замечательное представление, люди. Поистине прекрасно.

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: How one dies shows how one lived. And it was your masterpiece.
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Смерть показывает, какой была жизнь. И ваша смерть стала вашим шедевром.

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A rabbit!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Каким духом ты станешь? Да! Кроликом!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chihuahua!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Каким духом ты станешь? Да! Чихуахуа!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A sheep!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Каким духом ты станешь? Да! Овцой!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chicken!
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Каким духом ты станешь? Да! Курицей!

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: This is it...where shall I go now?
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Вот и всё... куда мне теперь идти?

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: All those memories will be lost in time, like tears in rain...
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Все эти воспоминания исчезнут во времени, как слёзы под дождём...

records.speaker: Thorn
records.source: [BOSS] Thorn: Congratulations humans, you may pass.
records.translation: [BOSS] Thorn: Поздравляю, люди. Можете пройти.
